text:
Stuffed with philosophy,

because of the eagerness that devours me,

I, who already knew

two grams of living, know nothing now.


From asking so much

the road from the wise men who passed,

I was left without arriving,

while so many fools arrived...

translation.title: Stuffed with Philosophy...
translation.editorial_note: This related version preserves the compact philosophical irony under its first-line title.
